title: House and Bell
author: A. M. Coldharbour
blurb: Orsen Fairweather, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the last resident signs the papers.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
